summary: Run setImmediate callbacks in Node's check phase after poll/I/O callbacks for the current iteration.

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.relative_to_io: scheduled Immediate callbacks run after the poll phase's I/O callbacks
semantics.turn: eligible in the check phase of an event-loop iteration

caveats: The setImmediate API handle/arguments contract is owned by node.timers.set-immediate; this rule owns phase ordering only.
Do not model check-phase work as arbitrary Task scheduling.

tests.name: I/O callback completes before its immediate
